gloss: independent travel; individual travel; traveling on one's own

definitions.gloss: independent travel; individual travel; non-group travel
definitions.explanation: Travel arranged and undertaken by an individual or small group independently, as opposed to organized group tours. The traveler plans their own itinerary, transportation, and accommodation.

examples.japanese: {個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{動|うご}ける→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: Individual travel allows more freedom of movement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My first trip abroad was as an independent traveler.

examples.japanese: ⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧や⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Whether a group tour or independent travel is better depends on your purpose and budget.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧ (individual; personal) + ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧ (travel; trip). Contrasts with ⟦{団体|だんたい}{旅行|りょこう}→団体旅行：22453_dantairyokou⟧ (group travel) and ⟦パッケージ→パッケージ：11699_pakkeeji⟧⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧ (package tour).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go as an independent traveler
- {個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}する→計画する：20998_keikakusuru⟧: to plan an independent trip
- {個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}{向|む}け: suited for individual travelers
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}: independent overseas travel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一人旅|ひとりたび}→一人旅：18216_hitoritabi⟧: solo trip; traveling alone — specifically one person, while {個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう} can include a couple or small group traveling independently
- ⟦{団体|だんたい}{旅行|りょこう}→団体旅行：22453_dantairyokou⟧: group travel — the opposite; organized tours with fixed itineraries
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: free travel — similar meaning, emphasizes the freedom aspect
- バックパッカー⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: backpacker travel — a style of budget independent travel
